name: frontend-slides
description: Create zero-dependency, animation-rich HTML slide presentations from scratch or by converting PowerPoint files.

displayDescription.en: Crafts zero-dependency, animation-rich HTML slide decks that run in any browser. Builds from scratch, converts PPTX, offers visual style previews, and exports to a live URL or PDF.
displayDescription.zh: 零依赖打造动画丰富的网页演示文稿，支持从零创建、PPTX转换与幻灯片增强，提供风格预览、在线部署与PDF导出。
